title: Steam Scraper: Games, Prices, Top Sellers & Reviews
desc: Scrape the Steam store: top sellers, new releases, specials and upcoming, keyword search and full game details (price, discount, genres, developers, Metacritic, review score). Steam reviews scraper with playtime and votes; schedule it as a Steam price tracker. No login. $1 per 1,000 games.

title: Greenhouse Job Scraper & New Job Alerts
desc: Scrape all open jobs from any Greenhouse job board (boards.greenhouse.io / job-boards.greenhouse.io) via the official Job Board API. Keyword, location and remote filters, plain-text descriptions, and an only-new-jobs monitoring mode.

title: Lever Job Scraper & New Job Alerts
desc: Scrape all open jobs from any Lever job board (jobs.lever.co and jobs.eu.lever.co) via the official Postings API: teams, locations, workplace type, salary ranges when published, descriptions. Filters and an only-new-jobs monitoring mode.

title: Ashby Job Scraper with Salary Data
desc: Scrape all open jobs from any Ashby job board (jobs.ashbyhq.com) via the official Job Posting API, with structured salary ranges (min, max, currency, interval), remote/hybrid flag, departments and descriptions. Salary-only filter and new-job monitoring.

title: ATS Jobs Scraper: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday & 5 more
desc: Get every open job from career sites on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee, Personio & Teamtailor. Auto-detects the ATS, one clean schema, keyword/location/remote filters, and an only-new-jobs monitoring mode.

title: Substack Scraper: Newsletter Posts, Likes & Comments
desc: Scrape posts from any Substack newsletter (subdomain or custom domain): title, subtitle, date, authors, likes, comments, wordcount, paid/free and full text of free posts. Date range, category discovery and a new-posts monitor mode.

title: SmartRecruiters Job Scraper & New Job Alerts
desc: Scrape all open jobs from any SmartRecruiters career site (jobs.smartrecruiters.com / careers.smartrecruiters.com) via the official Posting API: departments, locations, remote/hybrid, employment type, full descriptions. Filters and an only-new-jobs monitoring mode.

title: Workable Job Scraper & New Job Alerts
desc: Scrape all open jobs from any Workable careers page (apply.workable.com/<company>) via Workable's public jobs widget API: departments, functions, locations, remote flag, employment type, full descriptions. Filters and an only-new-jobs monitoring mode.

title: Recruitee Job Scraper with Salaries & Alerts
desc: Scrape all open jobs from any Recruitee career site (<company>.recruitee.com) via the public Careers Site API: salary ranges when published, departments, locations, remote/hybrid/onsite, employment type, descriptions with requirements. Filters and new-job monitoring.

title: Remote Jobs Scraper: Jobicy, Remote OK, Arbeitnow & ATS
desc: Remote jobs from Jobicy, Remote OK and Arbeitnow APIs plus remote roles straight from company career pages (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday & 5 more). One clean schema, salary, dedupe, source attribution and an only-new-jobs monitor.

title: Hacker News Scraper & Who Is Hiring Jobs Parser
desc: Scrape Hacker News front page, new, best, Ask, Show and job stories, full-text search with points and date filters, comments, and the monthly 'Ask HN: Who is hiring?' thread parsed into structured jobs (company, role, location, remote, salary). Official APIs.
